name: Mythic Bracers of Just Rewards contribute their converted PvE Power
contract: Mythic Bracers of Just Rewards (10020577) have 20 PvE Power in the Hellfire fixed budget. Equipping the bracers adds 1% creature damage and reduces incoming creature damage by 1%. This checks server combat independently of the client character sheet.

steps.label: Without PvE Power the player deals the base damage
Without PvE Power the creature deals the base damage
PvE Power +20 raises damage dealt to the creature by 1%
PvE Power +20 lowers damage taken from the creature by 1%
